master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game vehicle master, PNG true transparent background. Wide landscape canvas, target 3072 x 1536 pixels, minimum 1500 pixels wide. Reference role: approved Swamp Scout illustration style only. Premium semi-realistic painted game art, readable dark contours, fine mechanical details, weathered surfaces and rich natural texture. ICE BREAKER: one racing-green all-terrain cargo truck with high-clearance continuous rigid chassis. Front cab on RIGHT, long flatbed to left. Exactly EIGHT AXLES: eight clearly visible separate near-side tires, all same size 2-metre winter tires with conspicuous rows of STEEL SPIKES, frost and packed snow between tread blocks, matching bolted rims. Equal size on all axles. Snorkel, front winch with visible cable and hook, roof light bar, stowed crane boom and recovery spades. Frost and road-salt crust on lower green panels, remnants of dried mud. On flatbed a BIG transparent GLASS AQUARIUM TANK inside sturdy steel protective frame, securely strapped and bolted to deck. Inside a believable anatomically natural black and white ORCA, friendly calm demeanor without cartoon face, fully visible through glass and water, water sloshing near top with air gap and plausible reflections/refraction. Keep aquarium and orca large and readable, loaded securely within vehicle silhouette. Side view FACING RIGHT, restrained elevated angle showing some roof, deck and tread. Soft even daylight, no hard directional lighting. Whole loaded truck and all wheels visible with clear transparent margins. No ground, drop or cast shadow, colored halo, checkerboard, text, logos, watermark or people.
